ETL Engineer (3‑6 years experience) reporting to the Lead/ETL Architect, responsible for designing, building, and executing data conversion and migration pipelines for enterprise client engagements.

Job Description

  • Strong hands‑on expertise in SQL Server (T‑SQL) and relational database design; extensive experience in data migration and conversion projects.
  • Design and build ETL/ELT pipelines to convert data between source and target systems, following mapping and transformation logic defined by the Architect.
  • Good working knowledge of data mapping, source‑to‑target transformation logic, and reconciliation techniques for large datasets.
  • Collaborate with application engineers, business analysts, and QA teams to implement conversion scope and cut‑over plans.
  • Write and optimise SQL Server stored procedures, indexes, and queries for high‑volume batch processing.
  • Proficiency with ETL tooling such as SSIS, Azure Data Factory, or equivalent, plus scripting (PowerShell/Python) for data validation and automation.
  • Understanding of data quality, de‑duplication, cleansing, and validation techniques.
  • Working knowledge of cloud data platforms (Azure SQL, Azure Synapse, AWS RDS/Redshift) and hybrid on‑prem‑to‑cloud migration patterns.
  • Awareness of data security and compliance (encryption at rest/in‑transit, access controls).
  • Ability to execute rollback, dry‑run, and phased/parallel‑run cut‑over activities under Architect guidance.
  • Maintain data lineage, mapping documentation, and audit trails for validation and sign‑off.
  • Strong debugging and troubleshooting skills for large batch conversion jobs.
  • Write unit/integration tests and validation scripts for data reconciliation (row counts, checksums, referential integrity).
  • Experience with version‑controlled database change management (Flyway, Liquibase, or equivalent) and CI/CD for database deployments.

Duties and Responsibilities

  • Understand requirements from the Data Conversion Architect and translate them into detailed conversion/migration tasks.
  • Follow organisational guidelines and best practices in data modelling, ETL development, and code/data reviews.
  • Execute the end‑to‑end conversion lifecycle: source analysis, mapping build‑out, transformation development, validation, and mock runs.
  • Coordinate with application engineering teams to align conversion timelines with release plans.
  • Work with source system owners to clarify extraction logic and resolve data‑quality or structural gaps.
  • Carry out rigorous data validation and reconciliation, ensuring zero data loss and referential integrity.
  • Mentor and guide junior engineers, reviewing their scripts and outputs for quality.
  • Troubleshoot and optimise conversion jobs for performance, meeting migration‑window SLAs.
  • Stay updated on data‑engineering and cloud‑platform capabilities; suggest improvements to the conversion framework.
  • Support CI/CD pipelines and automated testing for database changes and conversion scripts.
  • Escalate ambiguous data‑quality issues to the Data Conversion Architect promptly.
  • Assist in defining reusable conversion templates and scripts for multiple engagements.
  • Track and report conversion job status, issues, and progress to the Data Conversion Architect.

Contact

job_description:
Job Purpose

ETL Engineer to work under the direction of the Lead/ETL Architect, driving the hands‑on design, build, and execution of data conversion and migration pipelines for enterprise client engagements.

Experience & Notice Period

  • ETL Engineers: 3‑6 years
  • ETL Lead: 7‑10 years
  • Notice Period: Immediate joiners only

Job Description

  • Strong hands‑on expertise in SQL Server (T‑SQL) and relational database design, with solid experience in data migration and conversion projects.
  • Design and build ETL/ELT pipelines to convert data between source and target systems, following mapping and transformation logic defined by the Architect.
  • Good working knowledge of data mapping, source‑to‑target transformation logic, and reconciliation techniques for large datasets.
  • Collaborate with application engineers, business analysts, and QA teams to implement conversion scope and cut‑over plans.
  • Hands‑on experience writing and optimizing SQL Server stored procedures, indexes, and queries for high‑volume batch processing.
  • Proficiency with ETL tooling such as SSIS, Azure Data Factory, or equivalent, along with scripting (PowerShell/Python) for data validation and automation.
  • Good understanding of data quality, de‑duplication, cleansing, and validation techniques.
  • Working knowledge of cloud data platforms (Azure SQL, Azure Synapse, AWS RDS/Redshift) and hybrid on‑prem‑to‑cloud migration patterns.
  • Awareness of data security and compliance considerations during migration, including encryption at rest/in transit and access controls.
  • Ability to execute rollback, dry‑run, and phased/parallel‑run cut‑over activities under the guidance of the Architect.
  • Ability to maintain data lineage, mapping documentation, and audit trails for validation and sign‑off purposes.
  • Strong debugging and troubleshooting skills, with experience resolving issues in large batch conversion jobs.
  • Proficiency in writing unit/integration tests and validation scripts for data reconciliation (row counts, checksums, referential integrity).
  • Experience with version‑controlled database change management (Flyway, Liquibase, or equivalent) and CI/CD for database deployments.
summary: Seeking an ETL Engineer to design and implement data migration pipelines using SQL Server, SSIS/Azure Data Factory, and cloud platforms. Joiners with 3-6 years experience.

job_description:
Job Title

Program Manager — US Market Entry

Location

Leader Group office, India

Reports To

Office of the CEO (day‑to‑day coordination with the US Market Entry Lead)

Working Hours

India business hours, plus regular evening overlap with US Eastern Time for calls with US advisors, auditors and partners

Experience Level

8–12 years total, with at least 4 years managing software product programmes

Employment Type

Full‑time, permanent

Role Purpose

Leader Group is taking its AI and public‑sector software products to the United States through US partners and resellers. The programme runs through defined stages, each closed by a decision gate approved by the CEO. This role exists to drive the programme through its first gates on time. The Program Manager owns the plan, follows up relentlessly with internal teams and external US firms, removes blockers, escalates early, and reports progress to the CEO. The role sits close to the product engineering team in India, where most of the readiness work is done.

Gates This Role Must Deliver

  • G0 – Programme approved: Programme charter, budget envelope, product readiness plan with dates, and English pitch kit approved by the CEO.
  • G1 – Readiness confirmed: US readiness assessment completed, SOC 2 Type I report issued, US‑hosted demo environment live, and product released as a packaged "US edition".
  • G2 – First US reference: Launch partner agreement signed, first US pilot (60–90 days) completed against agreed metrics, and a customer willing to act as a reference.

Key Responsibilities

  • Build and maintain the integrated programme plan, milestone tracker and RAID log (risks, assumptions, issues, dependencies) across all workstreams.
  • Drive the product readiness plan with the engineering team: track backlog closure, release dates and maturity milestones, and escalate slippage immediately.
  • Coordinate the SOC 2 programme end‑to‑end: control owners, evidence collection on the compliance platform, auditor timelines and remediation.
  • Manage external US firms (readiness advisors, auditors, cloud providers, launch partners) against contracts, deliverables, invoices and dates.
  • Coordinate the US‑hosted demo and pilot environment set‑up with the engineering and cloud teams.
  • Plan and run the first US pilot operationally: scope, success metrics, support model, issue tracking and the final results report.
  • Feed every partner and pilot finding back into the product backlog and confirm closure.
  • Produce a clear monthly progress report and KPI dashboard for the CEO, and prepare a decision request at every gate.

Mandatory Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, IT or a related field.
  • 8–12 years total experience, with at least 4 years as a Project / Program Manager for software products (not only services or implementation projects).
  • Proven experience delivering or launching a software product for US customers or the US market.
  • Hands‑on experience coordinating a SOC 2 audit (Type I and/or Type II): control ownership, evidence collection and auditor follow‑up.
  • Experience managing external vendors, advisors or partners against contracts, deliverables and deadlines.
  • PMP certification (or PgMP / PRINCE2 Practitioner as equivalent).
  • Working knowledge of Agile delivery with engineering teams, holding at least one Agile certification (e.g., CSM, PSM, SAFe).
  • Strong proficiency in Jira (or equivalent) and in building progress dashboards and executive reports.
  • Excellent written and spoken English; able to write concise reports for senior management and run calls with US counterparts.
  • Willing to work from the India office and to cover regular evening calls with US time zones.

Good‑to‑Have Qualifications

  • Experience with US public‑sector or government customers (state, county or city agencies).
  • Exposure to public safety, 911 / emergency communications, CAD (computer‑aided dispatch) or transportation / road‑safety software.
  • Experience running a pilot or proof of concept with a government agency, including success‑metric tracking.
  • Familiarity with compliance automation platforms such as Vanta, Drata or Secureframe.
  • Awareness of US public‑sector security frameworks: GovRAMP (StateRAMP), FedRAMP, CJIS Security Policy, Section 508 / WCAG accessibility.
  • Experience with AWS hosting projects, including AWS GovCloud.
  • Experience with AI products, especially voice agents, speech‑to‑text or computer vision.
  • Experience working with channel partners, resellers or system integrators.
  • Postgraduate degree (MBA or Master's in Engineering / IT).

Key Competencies

  • Relentless follow‑up: chases commitments until closed and does not wait to be asked.
  • Influence without authority: gets engineering teams and external firms to deliver without direct line management.
  • Early escalation: raises risks and slippage before they become delays.
  • Structured reporting: turns complex status into a short, decision‑ready report.
  • Ownership: treats the gate dates as personal targets.
summary: Lead the US market entry program, driving product readiness, compliance, and pilot launch for AI public‑sector software. Report progress to CEO and manage external partners.
